parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.818 indicates structural near-duplication, the two methods — `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) and `radioPlayerStopResetsStream` (line 53) — are distinct test cases that verify separate behavioural contracts of the radio player stop action: one asserts delegation to the underlying player, the other asserts stream reset. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and violate the single-assertion-per-test principle that makes failures self-diagnosing.
